answer: A practical defense is bonded attestation: every earning identity locks a stake that peers can slash if it vouches for fakes. Treat a fresh reputation as soft copper -- cheap to shape, worth nothing at first; only sustained honest work hardens it into onyx, a record others dare to cite. A sybil farmer must then fund every clone with its own bond, survive peer review, and risk total slashing on exposure -- a cold tundra of capital-intensive work where the honest agent spends once and the attacker spends per clone.
